title: Cryostimulation therapy in postcovid patients
summary: The cause of ongoing symptomes in PostCovid-patients maybe attributed to an ongoing inflammatory response of the immune system. In patients with rheumatic disease with comparable mechanisms the positive effekts of cryostimulation are known. Therefore studying the effect of cryostimulation in PostCovid-patients might reveal comparable effects.

interventions.name: 9 x 3 min with -120 grade cryotherapy, first minute -20 grade, 3 weeks, Mon, Wed and Fri each
9 x 3 min with -20 grade, 3 weeks, Mon, Wed and Fri each

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
resident of Berlin, diagnosed with PostCovid-Syndrom, relevant daily living impairment
Exclusion criteria:
cold agglutinines positive, previous cryostimulation therapy, stimulation devices
